title: Title: 15 years of out-of-sample tests on an automated FX portfolio – what do you think?
author: almog546
selftext:
I wrote it with ai so it’s will be more clear

I'm automating my manual prop-firm trading style (price-action / market-structure based) and would love some feedback before going to demo and live.

Setup

* Several different bots (independent rule-based systems) on one structure engine, 8 FX pairs.
* Backtested on 1-minute bid/ask bars. Costs included (spread + $7/lot commission). Swap not included (planning swap-free accounts).

How we tested

* Each bot was optimized only on a fixed set of years. Every other year is a test year and is never optimized on.
* Configs are frozen. A bot stays in only if its test-year total is above zero.

Results (test years only, 2007–2026, 2026 = half year)

* 2,172 trades, +174R
* \~12.9R a year on average
* 10 of 15 years up, 2 about even, 3 down (worst −34R)
* Max drawdown −67R

Prop firm check

* We simulated all the bots together on one prop account, trade by trade in time order, with real prop rules (5% daily loss, 10% static max loss).
* At 0.5% risk per trade, with risk cut to 0.15% after −5%, about 4% of accounts were blown within 2 years. The rest stayed profitable on average.

Next

* Demo with a monitoring dashboard, then prop accounts.
* Run the same locked bots on new pairs, gold and new timeframes.

Would love to hear what you think.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the step that worries me is "a bot stays in only if its test-year total is above zero". once the test years decide which bots survive, they've stopped being out of sample, you've optimized on them one level up. I'd hold back the last three years entirely, pick the survivors on everything before, and only then look at 2023 onward once.

comments.author: One-Next
comments.body: The first half of the curve is much worse than what yearly charts show. 2016 you are at the same level as 2007, that's a 9 year gap of no profit in total. It only starts to pick up after the volatility regime changes around 2017. Every system I've seen that abused that post-2016 has been in drawdown for the past 3-6 months.
